name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd.
business_summary: Hyderabad-based maker of generic APIs, custom-synthesis intermediates for global innovators and nutraceutical ingredients (carotenoids), almost debt-free. TTM sales Rs 11,230 cr, EBITDA Rs 3,967 cr (35%), PAT Rs 2,925 cr. Q1 FY27 (Jun 2026) sales Rs 3,080 cr (+28% YoY), OPM 41%, PAT Rs 902 cr. Valuation rich (P/E 90, market cap Rs 2.68 lakh cr) on custom-synthesis and GLP-1 supply expectations; shares +48% in 12 months and a Nifty 50 inclusion candidate.

exposures.mechanism: Market narrative (Citi 2026-09-23, CNBC TV18 2026-10-19) links Divi's to oral GLP-1 (orforglipron/oral semaglutide) intermediates and contract supply; Jun-26 OPM jumped to 41% from 30% a year earlier and sales +28% YoY. Scenario: +1 SSU = oral-GLP-1 adoption ahead of plan -> +10% FY28 EBITDA at 90x P/E, EV/MCap 1.0, persistence 0.8 -> ~+8. Counterparty names are NOT confirmed in a primary source I could retrieve; model knowledge/market reports only.

evidence.note: EU panel backs Eli Lilly oral GLP-1 pill; Divi's +2% (CNBC TV18/Equitypandit). Citi Buy, Rs 11,700 target on oral Wegovy upside (NDTV Profit 2026-09-23)

exposures.mechanism: ~85-90% of revenue is exports (model knowledge). +3% USD/INR: foreign-currency revenue ~+2.6% of sales; imported RM ~15% of sales x3% = -0.45%; net +2.1% of sales / OPM 35% = +6% EBITDA; hedging and 3-12m price re-negotiation, persistence 0.4, EV/MCap 1.0 -> +2.4, trimmed to 2.2. Empirical +1.61 (t=1.2) agrees in sign.

evidence.note: screener.in financials retrieved 2026-11-05; weight is model-derived (see mechanism)

exposures.mechanism: US 100% tariff on branded/patented drugs took effect 2026-09-29 with exemptions for India and 19 other jurisdictions on specialty drugs (Business Standard/Open Magazine headlines). Divi's sells APIs/intermediates not finished doses; API and generic inputs historically outside scope (model knowledge). Tail: +10pp tariff on API-linked flows -> customer renegotiation -3% of US-linked revenue (~30% of sales) -> EBITDA -3%, P/E 90 -> -1.5 prob-weighted.

evidence.note: US exempts select Indian speciality drugs from 100% tariff

exposures.mechanism: Pharma has so far been outside reciprocal tariffs on India (model knowledge); +10pp average tariff would hit sentiment mainly. Weight -0.8.
